title: hiCLIP
scope: Sugimoto 2015 hiCLIP implementation for STAU1-associated RNA duplexes, as depicted in the Illumina hiCLIP schematic and the hiCLIP row of the poster. Same-RNA and different-RNA origins share the depicted route. The distinct cloning and linker adaptors preserve duplex-arm association. Neighboring poster assays, controls, and unshown purification details are outside this extraction.

evidence.quote: Using hiCLIP, we studied RNA duplexes directly bound by STAU1, a double-stranded RBP that is important for mRNA localization10, stability11,12 and translation13.

The broad cDNA preparation is separated from readout because its product is the physical DNA library sequenced.
